stock.description: Moody Technology Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the manufacturing and sale of clothes and elastic webbings products in the People's Republic of China, Hong Kong, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Sales of Shoes, Clothes, and Others; Sales of Elastic Webbings; and Provision of Digital Marketing Services. It offers clothing products comprising T-shirt, jackets, pants, and hoodies, etc; elastic webbings products, such as certain types of dyed strap, including jacquard tape, knitted strap, and bundle strap, and others. It also provides digital marketing services, including performance-based advertising services, display based advertising services, and short video exposure services with third party platforms. In addition, it is involved in the manufacturing and sale of fabrics; asset management; and information transmission, software, and information technology services. The company was formerly known as Wang Tai Holdings Limited and changed its name to Moody Technology Holdings Limited in August 2018. Moody Technology Holdings Limited was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Huangmei, the People's Republic of China.
